summary: Iteration 5 focused on Partner CRM v2 + CAM Full-Form polish. BACKEND (17 new pytest cases, all passing, /app/backend/tests/test_iter5_partner_cam.py): GET /api/partners/performance 200 with kpis{active_partners:5,total_partners:5,mtd_disbursement:0,mtd_commission_accrued:1000000,overdue_payouts:0}, period 'Aug 2026', 5 rows; every row carries partner_uid/channel_code/name/monthly_target/disbursed_mtd/disbursed_total/commission_mtd/commission_payable/commission_overdue/attainment_pct + 6 trend_labels (2026-03..2026-08, ascending) & 6 trend_disbursed; rows verified sorted by disbursed_mtd desc; KPI totals reconcile exactly with the row sums and active_partners == count(status=='active'); unauth -> 401. PATCH /api/channel-partners/{uid}: monthly_target=7500000 returns updated doc (no _id), persists and immediately recomputes attainment_pct = disbursed_mtd/target*100 in /partners/performance; non-allowed keys (partner_uid, commission_total) silently ignored while allowed key notes persists; unknown uid -> 404; unauth -> 401. CAM PDF: GET /api/cases/CS-2026-000015/cam.pdf 200 application/pdf, starts %PDF-, 2401 bytes with Bearer and 2927 bytes with browser cookie auth (so the <a> download works in-browser); unknown case -> 404; unauth -> 401. POST /api/cases/{uid}/assessment persists ratios+flags+recommendation and reads back via GET /api/cases/{uid}. FRONTEND (Playwright, 1920x1080, session cookie as super_admin): /channel-partners renders partners-page with 4 KPI cards, 5-entry leaderboard, 5 partner-row-* rows; search 'Mumbai' -> 1 row, 'zzzznomatch' -> 0 rows + 'No partners match ...' empty row; row click opens partner-detail-modal with MTD Disbursement / Cases / Commission MTD tiles, 6-month sparkline (26-03..26-08) and target editor; target 7500000 -> toast 'Target updated' and after full reload the Rahul Sharma Associates row shows Target 75.00 L. CAM: /cases/CS-2026-000015 -> tab-cam -> cam-form visible; ratio borders exactly as specified: DSCR 0.8 = rgb(248,113,113) red, current 2 = rgb(52,211,153) green, FOIR 50 = rgb(251,191,36) amber, DSCR 1.7 = green. Auto-flags: DSCR 0.8 + FOIR 70 -> cam-suggestions with 2 suggestions; 'Accept ->' moves one into cam-flag-* and removes it from suggestions; cam-accept-all-btn consumes the remainder (suggestion block unmounts). cam-pdf-btn is an <A> with href https://credit-ops-5.preview.emergentagent.com/api/cases/CS-2026-000015/cam.pdf. cam-save-btn -> 'Assessment saved', after reload dscr=0.8 / foir=70 / current=2 and all 5 flags persist. REGRESSION: public landing loads, hero quick-apply created LD-2026-000057 and routed to /apply/thanks (lead deleted after), weekly.xlsx & weekly.pdf 200, global search 'Rohit' returns Leads 4 / Clients 2 / Cases 3 dropdown. Full backend suite: 83/84 pass (1 pre-existing seed-data failure, see minor issues).

minor.issue: No Pydantic model / validation: flags is stored verbatim, so a flag posted as a bare string (or any dict without level/id) is accepted. The CAM UI then renders it with FLAG_TONES[undefined] (unstyled, blank title), emits a React 'unique key' warning (data-testid becomes cam-flag-undefined) and Remove on it would drop every id-less flag. Validate flags as List[{level: green|amber|red, title: str, id}].

MTD windowing uses raw ISO string comparison (x.disbursement_date >= month_start_iso). Seed data mixes '...Z' and '+00:00' suffixes; any record stored with a non-UTC offset (e.g. +05:30) will bucket incorrectly. Parse to datetime before comparing.

tests/test_iter2_fixes.py::TestSeededData::test_bureau_checks_present now fails — db.bureau_checks holds only 1 doc (CS-2026-000039, created by a test run). No seeded case has a bureau pull, so CAM's bureau-derived auto-flags and the 'Bureau Score' snapshot are always '—' on demo cases.

issues: Seed data has zero MTD disbursement (only CS-2026-000001/11 are partner-linked and their disbursement dates are 2023), so MTD Disbursement KPI = Rs0, every leaderboard entry reads 'Rs0 - 0 cases' and every sparkline is a flat line pinned to the baseline. The new dashboard reads as broken/empty to a reviewer — seed 1-2 current-month partner disbursements + commissions.
Attainment 0.0% is shown in red for partners with a target but no MTD disbursement, next to 'No target' greys for the rest — visually noisy.

'Monthly disbursement target' label wraps to 2-3 lines at 2xl width and the AttainmentBar (with its % caption) is squeezed into the same flex row, so the 0.0% caption visually collides with the label block. Give the bar its own row or a min-width.
Radix warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' — add DialogDescription.

action_items: Seed at least one current-month disbursement + commission for 2-3 channel partners so the Partner CRM v2 KPIs / leaderboard / sparkline show non-zero data.
Validate the assessment payload (flags shape) server-side and make CAM's flag list key/testid fall back to index+title when id is missing.
Add DialogDescription to the partner detail modal and give AttainmentBar its own row in the target card.
Optional: restore seeded bureau_checks so CAM bureau auto-flags/snapshot are exercisable (test_iter2_fixes::test_bureau_checks_present is currently failing).
critical_code_review_comments: partner_performance() re-scans the full disbursements/commissions lists inside the per-partner loop (O(partners x disbursements)) — build dicts keyed by partner_uid once; fine for 5 CPs, will not scale.
MTD/overdue windows compare ISO strings instead of datetimes (offset-format dependent) — parse with datetime.fromisoformat.
PATCH /api/channel-partners/{uid} takes a raw dict; monthly_target is not type/range-checked, so a client can persist a string or negative target (allow-list protects the schema but not the values).

success_rate.backend: 100% (17/17 new iteration-5 cases; full suite 83/84, the 1 failure is a pre-existing seed-data gap)
